title: Computing Efficiently in QLDPC Codes (SHYPS Codes)
abstract: First demonstration of computation using SHYPS QLDPC codes, solving a decades-long challenge. SHYPS codes use non-local connectivity to encode multiple logical qubits in a single code block for up to 20x fewer physical qubits per logical qubit. Single-shot error checking per logical operation dramatically decreases clock cycle and runtime. Requires Photonic's Entanglement First architecture for the high connectivity needed.
key_claims: First to demonstrate computation using SHYPS QLDPC codes
Up to 20x fewer physical qubits per logical qubit compared to surface codes
Single-shot error checking per logical operation
Addresses decades-long challenge of computing within QLDPC codes
